risk_summary: The excerpt reports a substantial operating turnaround with detailed, quantified improvements, but the risk profile remains elevated due to prior financial statement restatements, internal control weaknesses, government investigations, COVID-19 and market volatility, and reliance on a fully drawn secured credit facility. Positive 2019 results are partly affected by approximately $30 million of customer-requested shipments pulled forward from 2020 and extensive use of adjusted non-GAAP measures.
